title: Hermes Rollback Flag
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 rollback flags. Every new behavior has a rollback flag defined in schema.

flag_id.description: Unique identifier for this rollback flag.

feature_name.description: Name of the feature this rollback flag controls.

rollback_flag_name.description: Name of the rollback flag parameter.

stored_in_policy_snapshot.description: Whether the rollback flag is stored in policy snapshot, not runtime state.

completely_disables_feature.description: Whether setting this flag completely disables the feature.

verification_steps.description: Steps to verify rollback was successful.

affects_live_behavior.description: Whether enabling this feature changes live behavior.
